first_unrecovered_deviation.summary: Agent did not start and no exception or container build logs are available to pinpoint the failure.

failure_manifestation.summary: Agent did not start and no exception or build logs are available.

primary_root_cause.summary: Insufficient log artifacts to determine why execution terminated prior to agent startup.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Agent produced invalid or missing simulation results.
missing_evidence: Positive behavioral, scientific, or contract-mismatch evidence implicating agent decisions
competing_hypotheses.counterfactual_test: Inspect agent trajectory and generated workspace files for explicit errors.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Available logs and artifacts cannot deterministically isolate a single root cause.
missing_evidence: Complete trajectory and verifier diagnostic logs
competing_hypotheses.counterfactual_test: Re-run with full runner and verifier logging enabled.

excluded_hypotheses.reason: Agent never started (`runtime.agent_started == false`); cannot blame agent without trajectory.

recommended_actions.action: Preserve runner `exception.txt` and `trial.log` when container setup aborts.
